discovery_answers.system: The accounting system is the system of record.

input.process_description: Accounts payable agents copy invoice totals from email attachments into the accounting system.

functional.acceptance_criterion: Given a supported attachment, the extracted total is displayed with its source location and a confirmation control before persistence.
functional.evidence: Agents copy invoice totals from email attachments into the accounting system.
functional.text: The system shall extract invoice totals from supported email attachments and present them for confirmation before writing to the accounting system.

open_questions.text: What is the monthly invoice volume?

input.process_description: Support agents answer repetitive password-reset questions.

functional.acceptance_criterion: Given a password-reset question, the system produces a draft response and requires agent review before it is sent.
functional.evidence: Support agents answer repetitive password-reset questions.
functional.text: The system shall provide a draft password-reset response that an authorized support agent can review before sending.

goals.evidence: Support agents answer repetitive password-reset questions.
goals.text: Reduce repetitive password-reset work for support agents.
